title: Right Triangle Trigonometry: SOH CAH TOA
seo_title: Right Triangle Trigonometry Worksheet: SOH CAH TOA (Geometry, G-SRT.C.8) | 100 Questions
standard_text: Use trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean Theorem to solve right triangles in applied problems.
meta_desc: Free Geometry worksheet on right triangle trigonometry: label opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse, choose sin, cos or tan, find sides and angles, and solve angle of elevation problems. 100 questions.
key_big: SOH CAH TOA: sin = O/H, cos = A/H, tan = O/A.
key_sub: Label the sides from the angle first. To find an angle, use sin⁻¹, cos⁻¹ or tan⁻¹.
body_html:
How it works

Label the sides from the angle θ: opposite (across from θ), adjacent (next to θ) and hypotenuse (longest, opposite the right angle). Then use SOH CAH TOA:

  • sin θ = O ÷ H
  • cos θ = A ÷ H
  • tan θ = O ÷ A

To find an angle, use the inverse buttons sin−1, cos−1, tan−1.

Example

The hypotenuse is 10 cm and the angle is 30°. Find the opposite side.

SOH: O = 10 × sin 30°.

Answer: 5 cm

Example

Opposite = 7 cm, adjacent = 9 cm. Find the angle.

TOA: θ = tan−1(7 ÷ 9).

Answer: 37.9°

Example

The adjacent side is 8 cm and the angle is 40°. Find the hypotenuse.

CAH: cos 40° = 8 ÷ H.

H = 8 ÷ cos 40°.

Answer: 10.4 cm

Common mistakes

  • Labeling the sides from the right angle instead of from θ.
  • Choosing the wrong ratio. Write down which two sides you have first.
  • Multiplying when the unknown is on the bottom: if sin 40° = 10 ÷ x, then x = 10 ÷ sin 40°.
  • Using sin instead of sin−1 to find an angle, or having the calculator in radians.

faq.q: What does SOH CAH TOA mean?
faq.a: sin = opposite ÷ hypotenuse, cos = adjacent ÷ hypotenuse, tan = opposite ÷ adjacent.

faq.q: How do I choose which ratio to use?
faq.a: Write down the two sides involved (the one you know and the one you want). The pair tells you the ratio.

faq.q: How do I find a missing angle?
faq.a: Work out the ratio of the two sides, then use the inverse button, for example tan⁻¹(7 ÷ 9). Make sure the calculator is in degree mode.

faq.q: Why is sin 30° equal to cos 60°?
faq.a: 30° and 60° are complementary. The side opposite one acute angle is adjacent to the other, so the sine of an angle equals the cosine of its complement.

What is the exact value of sin 30°?
What is the exact value of cos 60°?
What is the exact value of tan 45°?
items.e: In a isosceles right triangle opposite = adjacent, so tan 45° = 1.

items.q: What is the exact value of sin 45°?
items.e: In a 45°-45°-90° triangle with legs 1, the hypotenuse is √2, so sin 45° = 1/√2 = √2/2.

items.q: What is the exact value of tan 60°?
items.e: In a 30°-60°-90° triangle, tan 60° = long leg ÷ short leg = √3 ÷ 1 = √3.

items.e: A and B are complementary, and the side opposite A is adjacent to B. So cos B = sin A = 0.6.
